caption:
First AI draft not great? 🛠️ Don't start over. Make it critique itself.

1️⃣ Get the first draft
2️⃣ Say: "List 3 weaknesses in your answer, then rewrite it fixing them."
3️⃣ Compare the two versions

Still check the facts yourself. 📌 Save this prompt.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.
